root_cause: The login route is explicitly noindex, but inloggen.html was still included in PUBLIC_PAGE_EXCLUDES-derived public SEO inventory. The SEO gate therefore demanded sitemap presence for a route that must not be indexed.
prevention: Keep authentication/login utility pages excluded from the public SEO and sitemap inventory when they are explicitly noindex.
Do not resolve a noindex utility-page sitemap warning by indexing the utility route.
Guard the public SEO scope contract with an executable regression.
